Heard the learned counsel Sri.Gururaj R., appearing for the petitioners and the learned counsel Smt.Sowmya R., learned HCGP for respondent No.1 and Sri.P.L.Rajesh, appearing for respondent No.2.
2.

Criminal Petition No.656 of 2023 is filed calling in question the proceedings in C.C. No.46/2011 on the file of the IV ACJM & JMFC Court, Mysore, Mysore, registered for offences punishable under Sections 498A and 506 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act,
1961 against the petitioners--husband, mother-in-law and brother-in-law of respondent No.2 respectively.
3.

Criminal Petition No.722 of 2023 is filed calling in question the proceedings in C.C. No.3524 OF 2016 on the file of 4th ACJM and JMFC Court, Mysore, registered for offences punishable under Sections 498A and 506 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry NC:
2024:KHC:40473 Prohibition Act, 1961 against the petitioner--husband of respondent No.2.
4.
The parties were also before the Family Court in M.C.No.189 of 2015 on the file of the Prl. Family Court at Mysuru, wherein the marriage was dissolved by a decree of divorce.
5. During the pendency of the present petitions, the parties have resolved the dispute between them.
Applications are filed in both petitions before this Court under Section 320 of Cr.P.C., seeking compounding of the offences along with the affidavits filed by the petitioner and respondent No.2.
The applications and affidavits are taken on record.
6. The settlement also recognizes co-operation for withdrawal of the cases pending against the petitioners.
One of which is the present impugned proceedings.

The settlement insofar as narrates about the present proceedings, read as follows:

"Application under Section 320 read with Section 482 of Cr.P.C.

2. The Petitioner and Respondent No.2 herein have mutually agreed to compound the offences alleged in the above mentioned proceedings pending in the file of IV ACJM & JMFC, Mysore.
